fire: Local observers reported that there were several cases of arbitrary detention by police.
The constitution provides for freedom of the press; however, there were reports of harassment of journalists.
Human rights groups claimed that there was widespread corruption in the lower courts.
During the year there were no reports of politically motivated disappearances.
The government generally respected this right, although there were some restrictions on travel.
Nongovernmental organizations alleged that there were abuses in the prisons of the capital.

The law prohibits forced labor, but there were reports that it occurred in rural areas.
